subject: eps-processor

The eps-processor is consuming press releases from prwatch-body but producing zero output. Root cause identified:

SYMPTOMS:
- pr_discovered: 24
- pr_body_fetched: 24 (0 failures — bodies are flowing correctly)
- articles_published: 0
- oracle_total: 0 (pending/confirmed/contradicts all zero)
- eps-processor is not currently running (last log line: "shutting down")

ROOT CAUSE:
eps-processor logs show "ticker map loaded: 2 entries" repeating on every poll cycle. With only 2 tickers in the map, virtually every press release fails the ticker lookup and is silently dropped — no article is written, no oracle case is created.

Press releases seen in prwatch-body logs include companies like CLPS, BioArctic, Canoo, Sena — none of which

suggested_fix:
1. Locate the ticker map source file used by eps-processor (likely config/tickers.json or similar). Verify it contains the full watchlist — it should have hundreds of entries, not 2.
2. If the file is correct but the loader is broken: check internal/eps/processor.go (or equivalent) for the ticker map loading logic — it may be reading from a hardcoded test path or failing silently on a parse error
title: FatBaby obs [error]: eps-processor ticker map has only 2 entries — all press releases are being drop
